verdict.rationale: Elastic documents a fast path from zero to first search. There is a one-line `curl | sh` start-local install that sets up Elasticsearch and Kibana in Docker, a free serverless trial, and a quickstart that promises to 'index data and run semantic and hybrid searches in 10 minutes' in your preferred language. The semantic-search docs add that you only need to create an index mapping to start ingesting and querying. Missing for 10: step-by-step evidence of the index-creation, add-documents and search calls in the quickstart itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the time-to-first-search claim holds.
